dedupe_keys.name: transparent vs translucent multi band optical networking capacity and energy analyses

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. Physical-layer models and regenerator-placement algorithms compare transparent and translucent networks from C-band only through C+L+S+U transmission. The model tracks capacity, energy per transmitted bit and line-interface requirements. Coverage is numerical network-wide design comparison. Adding another transparent band can provide capacity comparable with regeneration in already-used bands at fewer interfaces. Companion results preserve the distinction between C+L+S and C+L+U energy efficiency. Reported trade-offs depend on the reference network and hardware assumptions. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The numerical analysis supports capacity planning and comparison of energy requirements.
